property_summary: For any caller and any guess hash, calling lockInGuess with 1 ether when the caller already has a pending guess must be rejected by the reference (it enforces no overwrite) whereas the mutant allows overwriting an existing guess; thus the reference never lets a second lockInGuess call succeed for the same caller without settling first, but the mutant sometimes does.
change_summary: Remove the requirement that previous guess block is zero, allowing callers to overwrite an existing guess and thus change the post-call stored guess value.
